entities.name: Query Ham1p-like pyrophosphatase
observations: 203 aa protein with Pfam Ham1p_like domain PF01725 spanning residues 5–192.
Sequence analysis identified close reviewed homologs annotated as dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases, with up to 61.1% identity and 97.0% query coverage.
The assignment is supported by homology and domain evidence; exact substrate preference is inferred rather than directly experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis to XMP
observations: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:28610 in homolog annotations.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis to dIMP
observations: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:28342 in homolog annotations.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis to IMP
observations: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:29399 in homolog annotations.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit for the pyrophosphatase reaction.
